description: What a hub answers when a rate-limited route family's token bucket is empty, or a stream-limited family's streams stay taken (`RateLimitRefusalV1`, `🔐️auth/🧬️schema`): `valid` holds one body per non-auth rate-limit class with the wait the limiter computes for an empty bucket of that class (its `costMs`) and one per stream-limit class with its policy's `retryAfterMs`; `invalid` are near misses a client must not accept as the typed refusal (Rust owned draft-07 validator and Ajv).
